mediaWork.title: The Suspect
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: The case of Hassan Diab, a Canadian citizen extradited to France for a 1980 bombing he maintains he did not commit; issues with extradition law; anti-terrorism prosecutions; potential wrongful accusation/conviction.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Diab spent over 3 years in French prison without charge before being released in 2018 due to lack of evidence, only to be convicted in absentia in 2023 based on allegedly flawed evidence.

featuredIndividuals.narrativeSummary: Dr. Hassan Diab was convicted in absentia in France in 2023 for the 1980 Rue Copernic synagogue bombing after spending over 3 years in pre-trial detention and being released due to lack of evidence. His extradition from Canada and subsequent conviction are controversial. Advocacy groups urge Canada to refuse any second extradition request.
